settings.name: HPD Southeast Substation
settings.description: smells of stale coffee and wet wool; fluorescent lights hum with a dying buzz — the bureaucratic heart of the investigation.

settings.name: Cattlemen’s Steakhouse
settings.description: sounds of clinking glass and low jazz; the air is thick with cigar smoke and expensive perfume — the place where secrets are traded.

settings.name: Buffalo Bayou
settings.description: feels oppressive and humid; the water is black and oily, reflecting the city’s neon glow — the site of the discovery and the final confrontation.

settings.name: Ship Channel
settings.description: smells of rust and diesel fuel; the cranes loom like skeletal giants against the twilight sky — the industrial artery of Houston’s corruption.

settings.name: Don’s Apartment
settings.description: feels cramped and lonely; the radiator clanks loudly in the night, echoing the silence of his empty bed — his sanctuary and his prison.

plot_points.description: Don identifies Tolbert’s body and notices the missing Rolex and tan line — establishes the murder’s precision.
Don visits the Cattlemen’s booth; Wanda refuses to name the patron, citing fear — introduces the witness and the intimidation.
(ticking clock, ch03) Bordelon assigns Don to mundane traffic duty, effectively sidelining him for 48 hours — the deadline begins.
Don visits his daughter Cassie; Trent Hollister is there, and Don feels a visceral distrust of the Hollister family — links the personal arc.
Jimmy finds the engraved lighter ‘R.T.’ on a dredging boat during a routine check; Don realizes the victim and the dredger are connected — the twist.
Don confronts Bordelon about the lighter; Bordelon threatens Don’s pension and hints at Cassie’s safety — the stakes spike.
(escalation, ch07) Don goes rogue, visiting the Ship Channel alone; he is ambushed by Hollister’s men — the physical danger begins.
(deepening, ch08) Jimmy reveals his pregnancy news to Don, seeking emotional support; Don realizes Jimmy is his only true ally — strengthens the bond.
(crisis, ch09) Jimmy takes a bullet meant for Don during the ambush; Don escapes but Jimmy is hospitalized — the cost of defiance.
(investigation, ch10) Don returns to the Cattlemen’s, threatening Wanda to speak; she reveals Amber Salazar was also on the boat — connects the cold case.
(breakthrough, ch11) Wanda gives Don the location of the ledger in the freezer; Don retrieves it, confirming Hollister’s guilt — the evidence is secured.
(confrontation, ch12) Wade Hollister tries to bribe Don at his home; Don refuses and arrests Wade on the spot — the climax of the personal arc.
(resolution, ch13) Bordelon is arrested based on the ledger’s financial trails; Don visits Jimmy in the hospital — the institutional defeat.
(aftermath, ch14) Don tells Cassie about Trent’s father’s arrest; Cassie leaves, heartbroken but understanding — the irrevocable loss.
(ending, ch15) Rita gives birth; Don watches the sunrise over the channel, the case closed but the city unchanged — the thematic conclusion.

voice: close third, gritty and procedural, grounded in sensory detail and dry, understated humor.
